turn_boundaries.text: Welcome to Topic 2: Spherical Mirrors & Ray Tracing. Next, examine spherical mirrors. Incoming rays parallel to the principal axis reflect directly through the focal point F.

turn_boundaries.speaker: host_2
turn_boundaries.text: Dr. Sarah, looking at the formula f = \frac{R}{2}, what's the key thing students usually trip over here?

turn_boundaries.speaker: host_1
turn_boundaries.text: Great question, Alex. The big takeaway is: Concave mirrors converge parallel rays; convex mirrors diverge them.
